record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace absolute padded-slot position IDs with cumulative nonpadding position IDs, assigning observed items positions 1 through history length and padding position 0. This may improve alignment between training prefixes and inference histories by removing position shifts caused by left padding. Retain truncation, recent-four-state pooling, final-real-position readout, features, embedding parameterization, causal backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer. Synchronize predictor metadata and writer.
